title: Benchmark raw rust-libp2p + custom bitswap in a minimal Rust harness
description:
Implement the minimal bitswap exchange needed to add/get a single CID block using raw rust-libp2p, without iroh or rust-ipfs. Run same 10,000-iteration benchmark. Artifact: minimal bitswap implementation, benchmark binary, results markdown.

Acceptance:
- Compiles on stable Rust edition 2021
- Implements Want/Have/Block exchange for a single CID
- Benchmark runs headlessly with cargo bench
- Results file with same metrics as iroh and rust-ipfs benchmarks
- LOC count of the bitswap implementation recorded (proxy for maintenance burden)
